book.name: Markus
book.title: Cau amsǝban a nê mala MARKUS

content: Yesu linǝ́ aɓwana á-ine
Aɓalǝ amǝno yia apwari ka, ɓwabundǝa yi ram kǝ̀rkǝ́r. Girlina pa kàm à nǝ̀ li ɗang. Yesu pǝlǝa tunǝ alaggana male sǝ nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Mǝsǝswatǝr mala ɓwapǝndǝa man bwalam kǝ̀rkǝ́r. À ndakani atàm nongŋo tàrú yalung, sǝ ko kǝgìr pà kàm à nǝ̀ li ɗang.
Ɓǝ̀ ǝn tasǝtea ama ɓǝa o nǝ nzala ka, mǝsǝpǝndǝa nǝ̀ mea a njargula, acemǝnana aɓea aɓwana ateà ka a puro aban sauwa.>>

content: Alaggana male pǝlǝi wi ama, <<A ya ban a ɓabondo man sǝ sǝm nǝ̀ kum girlina mana nǝ̀ linǝ́ ɓwapǝndǝa man ngga?>>
Yesu ɗia ama,

content.text: <<Agbatali bǝredi shen a bu wun ɗe?>>

content: À eare ama, <<Tongno-nong-ɓari.>>
Nda Yesu ne ɓwabundǝa ama ɓǝa dum nǝ do a nzali. Sǝ twal agbatali bǝredi mana tongno-nong-ɓari ka, oaso pakki Ɓakuli yàwá, sǝ ɓwanggia. Pea alaggana male ɓǝa gaki aɓwabundǝa, sǝ à gaki gbal.
À ndanǝ amǝ nji a buia bǝti. Yesu pǝlǝa pak yàwá amúrià gbal, sǝ banggia wia ama ɓǝa gaki aɓwana.
Ɓwapǝndǝa lili, à ɗǝmbǝo. Anzǝm man ngga, alaggana male tàrki cili aɓwangina girlina mǝnana à ueo ka, à lùmsǝ azace mǝgulke tongno-nong-ɓari.
Aburana kǝla á-ine à nda aɓalǝ aɓwabundǝa aban nì. Pǝlǝa Yesu ne ɓwabundǝa ama ɓǝa mǝsǝe, ɓǝà o a là.
Lang tsǝ̀ngŋǝ̀nà aɓwana a ndà ka, yi eauwe a waru andǝ alaggana male, pǝlǝa à nyare a bu-nzali mala ban mǝnana à tunǝki ama Dalmanuta ka.
Amǝ Farisi earce sǝn gir'lǝmdǝa
Lang amǝ Farisi ongŋǝna ama Yesu yina ka, à yiu à yì tita makgìr andǝi. À nǝ̀ kārǝki ka, à ɗì ama ɓǝ̀ lǝmdǝia wia gir'lǝmdǝa nǝ ban Ɓakuli, mǝnana nǝ̀ lǝmdǝ rǝcandǝa male ka.
Pǝlǝa Yesu tusǝ ɓālǝi kpǝm aɓa bangŋo male, sǝ na ama,

content.text: <<Palang sǝ aɓwana mǝnana a nza man kǝ earce sǝn gir'lǝmdǝa mǝ'pa ndali? Ən nggǝ na wun mǝsǝcau, pa mǝ nǝ pe aɓwana mǝnana a nza man kǝ gir'lǝmdǝa ɗang.>>

content: Pǝlǝa ɗekia, eauwe a waru, nyare a kusǝì o a ɓè nkaring nggeamùr.
Yis mala amǝ Farisiandǝ mala Hirǝdus
Alaggana ka ɓalǝia lorǝo à yiu nǝ girlina abuia ɗang, kǝ gbatali bǝredi mwashat na à ndanǝi aɓa waru ka.
Lang à ndarǝ o aɓa waru ka, Yesu nun kiria ama,

content.text: <<Wu parkir wun arǝ yis mala amǝ Farisi andǝ mala Hirǝdus.>>

content: À tita naki ce arǝarǝia ama bang anggo acemǝnana à yinǝ bǝredi a buia raka.
Yesu sǝlǝna rǝ cau mǝnana à nakiyi ka, pǝlǝa ɗia ama,

content.text: <<Palang sǝ wu kǝ naki acau arǝarǝ wun ama wu twal bǝredi a bu wun ɗang? Nggearǝ wun ngga, wu kǝ gandǝ súrǝ̀ gir ko wu bwalta gìr mbo? Ɓabum wun na più aɓa candǝe, kǝ gandǝ twal cau ɗang?
Amǝsǝ wun andǝ akir wun girki le? Ɓalǝ wun kasǝ arǝ kǝ cau re?
Mǝnana ǝn linǝ́ aɓwana á-tongno nǝ agbatali bǝredi tongno ka, cili mǝnana ueo, wu tàrki ka, wu pwano arǝ azace shen ɗe?>>

content: À ear ama, <<Lum nong-ɓari.>>
Yesu nyare ɗia ama,

content.text: <<Sǝ mǝnana ɗǝm ǝn linǝ́ aɓwana á-ine nǝ agbatali bǝredi tongno-nong-ɓari ka, cili mǝnana ueo, wu tàrki ka, wu pwan arǝ azace shen?>>

content: À eare ama, <<Tongno-nong-ɓari.>>
Pǝlǝa ɗia ama,

content.text: <<Ado ka wu súrǝ̀ gir mǝnana ǝn banggi cau amurí ka re?>>

content: Yesu mǝnbi nte mǝsǝì a Beseda
À yì bik Beseda. Aɓea aɓwana yiu nǝ ɓe nte. À yì zǝmbi Yesu ama ɓǝ̀ tsǝk buì arǝì, ɓǝ̀ mǝnbi wi mǝsǝì.
Yesu bwal nte a garabui pusǝì anzǝm la. Pǝlǝa tappî ntāra a mǝsǝì sǝ tsǝk buì a murí, sǝ ɗì ama,

content.text: <<A kǝ sǝn kǝgìr ado le?>>

content: Pǝlǝa nte man loasǝ múrí a kùli, na ama, <<E, ǝn nggǝ sǝn aɓwana, sǝ ǝn nggǝ sǝnia pepe ɗang. À nda kǝla anggun mǝnana à kǝ ging ngga.>>
Yesu nyare tsǝk abui a mǝsǝ nte mǝno ɗǝm, kara amǝsǝì mǝn gamama, kǝ sǝnban gǝraɗau.
Yesu tasǝ te ama ɓǝ̀ o a la, ne wi ama,

content.text: <<Ce a kar nǝ ɓá mǝnia yì muna-là ka ɗàng, ɓǝ̀ awu nǝ o ka.>>

content: Cau mana pur a kun Bitǝrusamur Yesu ka
Yesu lo andǝ alaggana male à nying bu-nzali Galili, à o arǝ amuna-là tù nǝ ban nggea-là Kaisariya Filipi. Amur njar ka, Yesu ɗia ama

content.text: <<Aɓwana kǝ bang ama mǝ nda yana?>>

content: À eari wi ama, <<Aɓea ɓwana kǝ na ama, a nda Yohana Mǝbatisǝma, aɓea ɓwana ka ama, a nda Iliya, sǝ aɓea ɓwana ka ama a nda ɓekǝ mǝɓangnǝa mala Ɓakuli.>>
Pǝlǝa ɗia ama,

content.text: <<Sǝ wun ngga, wu na ama mǝ nda yana?>>

content: Bitǝrus eare ama, <<A nda Kǝrǝsti, Mǝ'amsǝban.>>
Yesu nunkiria ama ɓǝa kǝa ne kǝɓwa cau amurí ɗang.
Yesu nacau amur lú male
Pǝlǝa tita banggia wia gìr mǝnana nǝ̀ kumi ka. Na ama,

content.text: <<Muna mala Ɓwa ka nǝ̀ nu tanni ɗàngɗáng. Aɓwana-mǝgule andǝ agbani pǝris, andǝ amalǝm Nggurcau mala Musa nǝ̀ ɓinǝ mǝsǝì, à nǝ̀ wal-luí. Sǝ a tàruià nongŋo ka, nǝ̀ lo nǝ yilǝmu.>>

content: Banggia wia mǝnia yì cau ka bwāng. Pǝlǝa Bitǝrus tunǝi a nkanggariban, gimbi arǝ cau mǝnana ne ka.
Yesu pǝlǝ rǝi sǝn alaggana male, pǝlǝa sà arǝ Bitǝrus ama,

content.text: <<Gǝshi banam, we Shetan! Ɗenyicau mo ka mala Ɓakuli na ɗang, mala ɓwapǝndǝa na!>>

content: Pǝlǝa tunǝ ɓwabundǝa, andǝ alaggana male, nea wia ama:

content.text: Ɓǝ̀ ɓwa twal ama nǝ̀ duk mǝkpatam ngga, dumǝna púp ɓwe nǝ̀ nying kpata agir mala ɓamúrì. Ɓwe nǝ̀ twal takusǝam aɓa gandǝrǝu mala nutanni andǝ lú ulang mem amur nggun-gangndǝi, sǝ nǝ̀ yiu atàm arǝ aban mǝnana kat mǝ nǝ ká akàm ngga.
Acemǝnana ɓwa mana kǝ earce amsǝ yilǝmi ka, nǝ̀ ɗwanyibanì, sǝ ɓwa mǝnana turta yilǝmi acem andǝ ce Cau Amsǝban ngga, nǝ̀ kumi.
Mana nǝ̀ purî ɓwa yì mǝnana ɓǝ̀ kum girbunda mala ɓanza kat, sǝ turta yilǝmi ka?
Mana gir nì na ɓwa na nǝi nǝ̀ pe Ɓakuli ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ kum yilǝmu mǝnana málá male pà kàm raka?

Ɓwa mǝnana kat kǝsǝkya kǝ pakki wi arǝàm sǝ arǝ cau mem aɓa mǝnia yì ɓanza mǝ ɗwanyi do nǝ mǝsǝcau aban Ɓakuli, andǝ mǝnana lùmsǝ nǝ cauɓikea ka, mim Muna mala Ɓwa ka, kǝsǝkya nǝ̀ pàkkam gbal arǝì a pwari mǝnana mǝ nǝ nyar nǝi aɓa ɓoarɓwa mala Tárrám, andǝ amǝturonjar mǝfele male ka.

footnotes.text: Ɓalli gbal aɓa: Ir 5:21; Ezǝk 12:2; Mar 4:12.
